name: Mac
title: ClipDiff for Mac
setup: The Mac repository has the current build and setup instructions. Its local release script builds ClipDiff.app and opens it. Finder integration is enabled separately in System Settings.
fileSetup: Choose Enable Finder menu… in ClipDiff, then enable ClipDiff Finder Integration in macOS System Settings.
singleFile: This works while monitoring is paused if a capture remains. If there is no capture, ClipDiff asks you to copy text or a file first while monitoring.
twoFiles: Finder can launch ClipDiff for this comparison, even if it is not already running. No previous capture is needed.
viewers: FileMerge, Kaleidoscope, Beyond Compare, or Visual Studio Code
